cohesion.title: Module 1 — Team Cohesion Analysis
criteria: The organization's vision for the next 10-15 years is clearly defined
All staff understand the organization's vision and values and can explain them clearly
All employees have embraced the organization's vision and values
Every employee knows their individual objectives and how they relate to overall goals
Every member is highly committed to achieving the team's objectives
All employees place the organization's interests above their personal interests
There is good vertical communication between Top Management and the rest of the organization
There is good horizontal communication between the different departments/directorates
There is a high level of trust between Top Management and the rest of the organization
There is a high level of trust among employees themselves
